tree.heading: Park
tree.text: The term “park” means the Lewis and Clark National Historical Park designated in section 410kkk–1 of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

notes.text: References in TextThis subchapter, referred to in introductory provisions, was in the original “this title”, meaning title I of Pub. L. 108–387, Oct. 30, 2004, 118 Stat. 2234, which is classified principally to this subchapter. For complete classification of title I to the Code, see Short Title note below and Tables.

Short TitlePub. L. 108–387, title I, § 101, Oct. 30, 2004, 118 Stat. 2234, provided that: “This title [enacting this subchapter and repealing sections 450mm to 450mm–3 of this title] may be cited as the ‘Lewis and Clark National Historical Park Designation Act’.”
